title: Tank Blitz
lines: Following the overwhelming response and competitive success of the Covert Tank , MOTIV is proud to present the next stage in microcell polymer technology, the Tank Blitz.
The solid red Tank Blitz with its 2000 Grit LSS finish provides a new shape for competitive bowlers and also gives average bowlers a very early and smooth option for medium oil conditions.
